# E1.4 — Events

<!-- Generated by: Opus (claude-opus-4-6) via /plan-epic command -->
<!-- Status: PLAN REVIEW — awaiting founder approval before implementation -->

---

## 1. Overview

E1.4 Events builds the fourth and final content type for the M1 private alpha: single-occurrence, time-bound, fixed-venue experiences with community RSVP. This epic covers the full lifecycle — creation wizard, event detail page, free RSVP, and the event feed card — plus the API layer (7 endpoints, atomic capacity management). Events were originally V2 scope and were promoted to M0 per DD-025 because the community-meetup use case is core to the Travel + Stories launch verticals. The M1 implementation is scoped to **free events only**: `pricing_model` is forced to `'free'`, `price_paisa` is forced to `0`, and no KYC check is applied. Paid events will be unlocked in E2.3 when the Razorpay booking flow is ready. After this epic, all four content types (Post, Itinerary, Event, Scheduled Experience) are creatable — completing the M1 alpha content creation surface.

## 2. SRS Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Notes / Scope Decisions |
|----|-------------|------------------------|
| CRT-FR-013 | Create an Event: single-occurrence, time-bound, fixed-venue, under 24 hours. Fields: title, description (max 500 chars), cover image, start_at + end_at (same day for M0), venue name + address (public), city, capacity, is_free/price. `event_occurrences` row created on publish. RSVP creates booking with price=0. `spots_booked` updated transactionally. (DD-025, DD-022) | M1 scope: free events only. Paid events deferred to E2.3. No KYC check for free events. same-day constraint enforced. |
| CRT-FR-014 | Content type picker: 4 cards (Post, Event, Scheduled Experience, Itinerary). KYC badge on paid types. Tapping a card starts the wizard. | Already built in E1.1. E1.4 adds the Event card being enabled and routing to the event wizard. |
| CRT-FR-015 | Publishing wizard framework: shared step shell, progress bar, auto-save every 30s, abandon + resume. | Already built in E1.1. E1.4 uses the shell; no changes to the framework itself. |
| CRT-FR-018 | Basics step: title (5–100 chars) + description (0–280 chars) with live counters. Warning at 85%, error at 100%, Next disabled at 100%. | Event overrides description limit to 500 chars per CRT-FR-013. The step component must accept a `maxDescription` parameter. |
| DD-025 | Events vs Scheduled Experiences: distinct types, events promoted to M0. Events = single date/time, public venue, community RSVP feel. `event_occurrences` table. | Architecture decision: use `event_occurrences` table (not `scheduled_dates`). Free events never require KYC. |
| SOC-FR-005 | WhatsApp share as first-class action on all content detail pages. | Event detail page must include WhatsApp share button (native share sheet with deep link). |

## 5. Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Chosen approach | Rejected alternative | Rationale |
|----------|----------------|---------------------|-----------|
| Draft event field storage | Store event-specific fields in `event_occurrences` table from the start (row created when wizard begins, nullable fields). On publish, all nullable fields are validated to be non-null by the application. Requires migration 014 to drop NOT NULL constraints on the event-specific columns. | Store in `content.vertical_data` JSONB | Founder decision: use a proper table. Gives typed columns, queryable fields, consistent data model. PostgreSQL CHECK constraints pass for NULL values (result is UNKNOWN, not FALSE) so the existing `CHECK (end_at > start_at)` is safe during draft. |
| Migration 014 — nullable event_occurrences | New migration drops NOT NULL on: `start_at`, `end_at`, `venue_name`, `venue_address`, `venue_point`, `city_id`, `capacity`. Adds `is_free` default. Application enforces required-on-publish at runtime. | New `event_draft_data` table | One table is simpler. The row's nullability tells you nothing about status — `content.status` is the source of truth for draft vs published. |
| Atomic RSVP capacity check | Single `UPDATE event_occurrences SET spots_booked = spots_booked + 1 WHERE content_id = $1 AND spots_booked < capacity RETURNING spots_booked` — no separate SELECT | SELECT to read capacity, then conditional INSERT | Single atomic statement eliminates the race condition window entirely. If 0 rows returned, the event is full. No transaction overhead needed. |
| M1 free-only enforcement | Force `pricing_model = 'free'`, `price_paisa = 0`, `is_free = true` in `publishEvent()` regardless of input | Accept pricing fields and rely on validation | Prevents any M1 code path from accidentally enabling paid events before the Razorpay integration (E2.3) is ready. A runtime guarantee is stronger than a validation guarantee. |
| Draft resume vs new draft | On wizard start, check for existing `type='event'` draft. If found, offer "Continue draft?" or "Start new?". "Start new" soft-deletes the old draft. | Allow multiple concurrent drafts | SRS CRT-FR-023: one draft per user per content type in MVP. Soft-delete pattern reuses `content.status = 'deleted'` from E1.1. |
| Post-publish editing | Published events are NOT editable in M1. Creator must unpublish → edit → republish. | Allow field edits after publish | Avoids "notify RSVP'd users of change" complexity. Consistent with itinerary publish behavior. |
| Unpublish behaviour | When creator unpublishes, set all existing bookings to `status = 'cancelled'` + reset `spots_booked = 0`. Send push notification to all affected users (FCM via E1.9 notification service; fire-and-forget in M1). | Hard-delete booking rows | Soft-cancel preserves booking history for analytics and audit. Notification is a first-class requirement (founder decision). |
| "What to bring" data | Predefined suggestions stored in Flutter code as `Map<String, List<String>>` (keyed by vertical/sub-category, e.g. `'travel': ['Water bottle', 'Sunscreen', ...]`). Creator sees a drawer with category-appropriate checkboxes + free-text add. DB stores selected items as `TEXT[]` in a new `what_to_bring` column on `event_occurrences`. | JSONB in vertical_data | Typed column is queryable. Drawer UI pattern is clear: check from presets OR type custom. Data structure in DB is a simple array of selected strings. |

## 6. Database

### Tables touched

| Table | Operation | Schema change? | Notes |
|-------|-----------|---------------|-------|
| `content` | R/W | No | `type = 'event'`; `vertical_data` stores only non-structural optional fields (dress_code, age_restriction) |
| `event_occurrences` | R/W | **Yes — migration 014** | Row created when wizard starts (nullable fields). Populated step by step. Updated atomically on RSVP. |
| `bookings` | R/W | No | Created on RSVP (free: `price_paisa = 0`, `status = 'confirmed'`). Soft-cancelled on unpublish (status → 'cancelled'). |
| `media` | R/W | No | Cover images attached to event content |
| `users` | R | No | Creator info for detail page, attendee avatars |
| `cities` | R | No | City name for display |

### Migration 014 — event_occurrences nullable columns

```sql
-- 014_event_occurrences_nullable.sql
-- Makes event field columns nullable to support draft-time partial saves.
-- Application validates all fields are non-null before publish.

ALTER TABLE event_occurrences
  ALTER COLUMN start_at      DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN end_at        DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN venue_name    DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN venue_address DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN venue_point   DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN city_id       DROP NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN capacity      DROP NOT NULL;

-- Add what_to_bring column (selected items, stored as text array)
ALTER TABLE event_occurrences
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS what_to_bring TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}';

-- Drop capacity > 0 check (can't enforce during draft when capacity is null)
ALTER TABLE event_occurrences
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS event_occurrences_capacity_check;

-- Re-add capacity check as conditional (only enforced when non-null)
ALTER TABLE event_occurrences
  ADD CONSTRAINT event_occurrences_capacity_check
    CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity > 0);
```

### Key queries

```sql
-- ── Upsert event_occurrences row on draft save ────────────────────────────────
INSERT INTO event_occurrences (content_id)
VALUES ($1)
ON CONFLICT (content_id) DO UPDATE
  SET start_at      = COALESCE($2, event_occurrences.start_at),
      end_at        = COALESCE($3, event_occurrences.end_at),
      timezone      = COALESCE($4, event_occurrences.timezone),
      venue_name    = COALESCE($5, event_occurrences.venue_name),
      venue_address = COALESCE($6, event_occurrences.venue_address),
      venue_point   = COALESCE($7, event_occurrences.venue_point),
      city_id       = COALESCE($8, event_occurrences.city_id),
      capacity      = COALESCE($9, event_occurrences.capacity),
      what_to_bring = COALESCE($10, event_occurrences.what_to_bring);
-- Called from updateEvent() service function. Only non-null params overwrite existing values.

-- ── Get event detail (authenticated request) ──────────────────────────────────
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.title,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.user_id,
  c.vertical,
  c.vertical_data,
  c.search_vector,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  eo.start_at,
  eo.end_at,
  eo.timezone,
  eo.venue_name,
  eo.venue_address,
  ST_X(eo.venue_point::geometry) AS venue_lng,
  ST_Y(eo.venue_point::geometry) AS venue_lat,
  eo.city_id,
  eo.capacity,
  eo.spots_booked,
  eo.rsvp_count,
  eo.is_free,
  eo.what_to_bring,
  u.id AS creator_id,
  u.display_name AS creator_name,
  u.username AS creator_username,
  u.avatar_url AS creator_avatar,
  (
    SELECT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings
      WHERE content_id = c.id AND user_id = $2 AND status != 'cancelled'
    )
  ) AS has_rsvpd
FROM content c
JOIN event_occurrences eo ON eo.content_id = c.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
WHERE c.id = $1
  AND c.type = 'event'
  AND (c.status = 'published' OR c.user_id = $2);
-- Returns 0 rows (→ 404) for non-owner accessing draft

-- ── Get first 4 attendees + total count ──────────────────────────────────────
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.display_name,
  u.avatar_url,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE b.content_id = $1
  AND b.status = 'confirmed'
ORDER BY b.created_at ASC
LIMIT 4;

-- ── Atomic RSVP: increment spots_booked only if capacity not reached ─────────
UPDATE event_occurrences
SET
  spots_booked = spots_booked + 1,
  rsvp_count   = rsvp_count + 1
WHERE content_id = $1
  AND spots_booked < capacity
RETURNING spots_booked;
-- 0 rows returned → event is full → 409

-- ── Atomic cancel RSVP: decrement, prevent going negative ─────────────────────
UPDATE event_occurrences
SET
  spots_booked = GREATEST(spots_booked - 1, 0),
  rsvp_count   = GREATEST(rsvp_count - 1, 0)
WHERE content_id = $1
RETURNING spots_booked;

-- ── List upcoming published events ────────────────────────────────────────────
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.title,
  c.user_id,
  eo.start_at,
  eo.end_at,
  eo.venue_name,
  eo.city_id,
  eo.capacity,
  eo.spots_booked,
  eo.is_free,
  u.display_name AS creator_name,
  u.avatar_url   AS creator_avatar,
  m.url          AS cover_image_url
FROM content c
JOIN event_occurrences eo ON eo.content_id = c.id
JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT url FROM media
  WHERE content_id = c.id AND media_type = 'image'
  ORDER BY sort_order ASC
  LIMIT 1
) m ON true
WHERE c.type = 'event'
  AND c.status = 'published'
  AND eo.start_at >= NOW()
  AND ($1::text IS NULL OR eo.city_id = $1)           -- city_id filter
  AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR eo.start_at >= $2)  -- from_date filter
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR c.vertical = $3)           -- vertical filter
  AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR c.user_id = $4)            -- creator filter
  -- Cursor pagination: (start_at, id) > cursor
  AND (eo.start_at, c.id) > ($5::timestamptz, $6::uuid)
ORDER BY eo.start_at ASC, c.id ASC
LIMIT $7;
```

### RLS policies needed

| Table | Policy name | Rule |
|-------|-------------|------|
| `event_occurrences` | `event_occurrences_select` | Published events visible to all authenticated + unauthenticated users; draft only to owner (`content.user_id = auth.uid()`) |
| `event_occurrences` | `event_occurrences_insert` | Only service role (API inserts via service key, not client SDK) |
| `event_occurrences` | `event_occurrences_update` | Only service role |
| `bookings` | `bookings_select_own` | User can only read their own bookings |
| `bookings` | `bookings_insert` | Only service role |
| `bookings` | `bookings_delete` | Only service role |

> **Note:** All DB writes go through the Hono API with the service role key. RLS policies exist as a defence-in-depth layer, not the primary auth check.

## 7. API Endpoints

### `POST /api/v1/events`
**Auth:** `authenticate` (required)
**Rate limit:** 10 creates per user per hour
**Request body (Zod schema):** `createContentSchema` (existing, with `type: 'event'`)
```json
{
  "vertical": "travel",
  "sub_category_id": "string (optional)"
}
```
**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "draft",
    "type": "event"
  }
}
```
**Headers:** `Location: /api/v1/events/{id}`
**Errors:**
- `401` — unauthenticated
- `429` — rate limit exceeded

---

### `GET /api/v1/events`
**Auth:** `optionalAuthenticate`
**Query params (Zod schema):** `eventListQuerySchema`
```
city_id?:    string
from_date?:  ISO 8601 datetime
vertical?:   string
user_id?:    uuid (filter by creator)
cursor?:     string (base64-encoded: "start_at|id")
limit?:      integer (default 20, max 50)
```
**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "uuid",
        "title": "string",
        "start_at": "ISO 8601",
        "end_at": "ISO 8601",
        "venue_name": "string",
        "city_id": "string",
        "capacity": 50,
        "spots_booked": 12,
        "is_free": true,
        "cover_image_url": "string | null",
        "creator": {
          "id": "uuid",
          "display_name": "string | null",
          "avatar_url": "string | null"
        }
      }
    ],
    "next_cursor": "string | null"
  }
}
```
**Errors:**
- `422` — invalid query params

{
  "title": "string (5-100, optional)",

### `POST /api/v1/events/:id/publish`
**Auth:** `authenticate` (required)
**Request body (Zod schema):** `publishContentSchema` (existing)
```json
{ "tnc_accepted": true }
```
**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "published",

      "start_at": "ISO 8601",
      "venue_name": "string",

    }
  }
}
```
**Errors:**
- `400` — validation failure (list each failing field):
  ```json
  {
    "type": "https://creatorhub.in/errors/validation-failed",
    "title": "Validation failed",
    "status": 400,
    "detail": "Event cannot be published. See errors for details.",
    "errors": [
      { "field": "venue_name", "message": "Venue name is required to publish" },
      { "field": "start_at", "message": "Event start time must be in the future" }
    ]
  }
  ```
- `401` — unauthenticated
- `403` — not the owner
- `404` — event not found
- `422` — already published / wrong state

### `POST /api/v1/events/:id/rsvp`
**Auth:** `authenticate` (required)
**Rate limit:** 10 RSVPs per user per hour
**Request body:** (empty — no body required)
**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "booking_id": "uuid",
    "event_id": "uuid",
    "status": "confirmed",
    "spots_booked": 13
  }
}
```
**Headers:** `Location: /api/v1/bookings/{booking_id}`
**Errors:**
- `401` — unauthenticated
- `404` — event not found
- `409` — `{ "code": "event_full", "detail": "This event is at capacity" }`
- `409` — `{ "code": "already_rsvpd", "detail": "You have already RSVP'd to this event" }`
- `422` — `{ "code": "own_event", "detail": "You cannot RSVP to your own event" }`
- `422` — `{ "code": "event_past", "detail": "This event has already happened" }`
- `429` — rate limit exceeded

---

### `DELETE /api/v1/events/:id/rsvp`
**Auth:** `authenticate` (required)
**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "event_id": "uuid",
    "spots_booked": 12
  }
}
```
**Errors:**
- `401` — unauthenticated
- `404` — no existing RSVP for this user
- `422` — `{ "code": "event_past", "detail": "Cannot cancel RSVP for past events" }`

// packages/shared/src/schemas/index.ts — add:

export const updateEventSchema = z.object({
  title:          z.string().min(5).max(100).optional(),
  description:    z.string().max(500).optional(),
  start_at:       z.string().datetime().optional(),
  end_at:         z.string().datetime().optional(),
  timezone:       z.string().optional(),
  venue_name:     z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  venue_address:  z.string().max(500).optional(),
  venue_lat:      z.number().min(-90).max(90).optional(),
  venue_lng:      z.number().min(-180).max(180).optional(),
  city_id:        z.string().optional(),
  capacity:       z.number().int().min(1).max(10000).optional(),
  tags:           z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(5).optional(),
  sub_category_id: z.string().optional(),
  vertical_data:  z.object({
    what_to_bring:   z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    dress_code:      z.string().optional(),
    age_restriction: z.string().optional(),
  }).optional(),
})

export const eventListQuerySchema = z.object({
  city_id:   z.string().optional(),
  from_date: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  vertical:  z.string().optional(),
  user_id:   z.string().uuid().optional(),
  cursor:    z.string().optional(),
  limit:     z.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(20),
})

  venue_name:      string
  city_id:         string
  capacity:        number
  spots_booked:    number
  is_free:         boolean
  cover_image_url: string | null
  creator:         CreatorSummary
}

export interface EventVerticalData {
  // Optional extras stored in content.vertical_data JSONB
  // what_to_bring is a typed TEXT[] column on event_occurrences, NOT here
  dress_code?:      string | null
  age_restriction?: string | null
}

export interface AttendeeItem {
  id:           string
  display_name: string | null
  avatar_url:   string | null
}

## 10. Security Considerations

| Risk | Mitigation | Applies here? |
|------|-----------|--------------|
| Capacity oversell (race condition on last RSVP) | Atomic `UPDATE event_occurrences SET spots_booked = spots_booked + 1 WHERE content_id = $1 AND spots_booked < capacity RETURNING spots_booked` — single statement, no SELECT-then-UPDATE gap. If 0 rows returned → 409. | Yes — critical |
| Unauthorized RSVP (unauthenticated user) | `authenticate` middleware on RSVP endpoint. 401 for missing/invalid token. | Yes |
| Blocked user RSVP | Check `users.status = 'active'` before allowing RSVP. Return 403 if suspended. | Yes |
| Creator RSVPing own event | Explicit check: `if (userId === event.user_id) throw 422 "own_event"`. | Yes |
| RSVP spam / DDoS | Rate limit: 10 RSVPs per user per hour using existing `rateLimit` middleware. | Yes |
| Past event RSVP | Check `event_occurrences.start_at > NOW()` before allowing RSVP. Return 422 "event_past". | Yes |
| Duplicate RSVP | Check existing booking before insert. Return 409 "already_rsvpd". | Yes |
| IDOR on event update/publish | `verifyContentOwnership()` pattern from itinerary service: fetch content row, check `user_id === userId`. Return 403 if mismatch. | Yes |
| Draft event info leak | Non-owner accessing draft event gets 404 (not 403) to avoid leaking existence. Same pattern as posts and itineraries. | Yes |
| SQL injection | All queries use Supabase parameterized client (`.eq()`, `.filter()`, template literals with typed params). Never string concatenation. | Always |
| KYC bypass for paid events | Not applicable in M1 (all events forced free). In E2.3, `requireKYC` middleware added when `price_paisa > 0`. | N/A (M1 free only) |
| Spots_booked going negative on cancel | Use `GREATEST(spots_booked - 1, 0)` in the decrement query to prevent negative values. | Yes |

## 11. Edge Cases & Error States

### Creation wizard
- [ ] User has an existing event draft → "Continue draft?" prompt or "Start new?" (soft-delete old draft on "Start new")
- [ ] Title < 5 chars at step transition → inline validation error, Next button disabled
- [ ] Description > 500 chars → counter turns red at 100%, cannot proceed
- [ ] `start_at` in the past → inline error "Event must be in the future"
- [ ] `start_at` after `end_at` → inline error "End time must be after start time"
- [ ] `start_at` and `end_at` on different calendar days → inline error "Events must start and end on the same day"
- [ ] `end_at - start_at` > 24 hours → inline error "Events must be under 24 hours"
- [ ] Capacity = 0 → validation error "Minimum capacity is 1"
- [ ] Capacity > 10,000 → validation error "Maximum capacity is 10,000"
- [ ] Venue name empty → required field error on step transition
- [ ] Venue address empty → required field error on publish
- [ ] City not selected → required field error on publish
- [ ] Venue coordinates (lat/lng) not provided → required field error on publish
- [ ] No cover image at publish → "Events require at least 1 image"
- [ ] Auto-save failure → show "Save failed" indicator, retry silently (don't block creator)
- [ ] Back navigation → each step retains all entered data (no data loss)
- [ ] Wizard exit with unsaved changes → "Discard changes?" confirmation dialog

### RSVP
- [ ] Event at capacity → RSVP button replaced by "Event is full" disabled state
- [ ] User already RSVP'd → button shows "You're going ✓", tap opens "Cancel RSVP?" confirmation
- [ ] RSVP cancelled → `spots_booked` decremented atomically, spot freed immediately
- [ ] Race condition: two users RSVP last spot simultaneously → atomic UPDATE ensures exactly one succeeds, other gets 409 "event_full"
- [ ] Creator views own event → hide RSVP bar, show "You're hosting this" label
- [ ] Guest (unauthenticated) taps RSVP → soft auth wall bottom sheet (E0.3 pattern)
- [ ] RSVP on past event → 422 "This event has already happened"
- [ ] RSVP on unpublished event → 404
- [ ] Cancel RSVP on past event → 422 "Cannot cancel RSVP for past events"
- [ ] Creator unpublishes event with existing RSVPs → all bookings set to `status='cancelled'`, `spots_booked` reset to 0, push notification sent to each RSVP'd user ("The event '{title}' has been cancelled")
- [ ] Rate limit exceeded → 429 with Retry-After header

### Event detail page
- [ ] Loading state → skeleton shimmer matching detail layout (date block skeleton, facts grid skeleton, body skeleton)
- [ ] 404 event → "Event not found" empty state with back button
- [ ] Draft event viewed by non-owner → 404 (not 403)
- [ ] Past event (`start_at < now`) → "Event has passed" banner, hide RSVP bar, show "Ended" badge
- [ ] Event at capacity (user hasn't RSVP'd) → "Event is full" badge, RSVP button disabled
- [ ] User has RSVP'd → bottom bar shows "You're going ✓" with "Cancel RSVP" secondary action
- [ ] 0 attendees → hide "Who's going" section entirely
- [ ] No cover image → placeholder with calendar icon
- [ ] Long description → show all text (no "read more" truncation)
- [ ] Deep link `/events/{id}` → resolves to event detail screen

### API
- [ ] Publish without required event fields → 400 with field-level errors
- [ ] Publish with `start_at` in past → 400 "Event start time must be in the future"
- [ ] Publish with `start_at`/`end_at` on different days → 400 "Events must start and end on the same day"
- [ ] Publish with no cover image → 400 "Events require at least 1 image"
- [ ] List events with invalid cursor → ignore cursor, return first page
- [ ] List events: default sort is upcoming only (`start_at >= now`), past excluded unless `include_past=true`

## 13. Open Questions / Risks

> **All 6 questions resolved by founder on 2026-04-14.** No open questions remain.

| # | Question | **Decision (final)** |
|---|----------|---------------------|
| 1 | Where to store draft event fields? | **`event_occurrences` table** (not JSONB). Migration 014 makes the required columns nullable. Row upserted as creator fills each step. Validated non-null on publish. |
| 2 | Event list default: upcoming-only or all? | **Upcoming only** (`start_at >= now`). `include_past=true` param opts in to past events. |
| 3 | Can creator edit after publishing? | **NO** — must unpublish → edit → republish. |
| 4 | RSVPs when creator unpublishes? | **Soft-cancel all bookings** (`status = 'cancelled'`), reset `spots_booked = 0`, **push notification to every RSVP'd user**. Not hard-delete — preserve history. |
| 5 | "What to bring" — structured or free text? | **Drawer with category-based predefined checkboxes + free-text add.** Predefined suggestions stored in Flutter as `Map<String, List<String>>` (vertical/sub-category → items). DB stores selected items as `TEXT[]` in `event_occurrences.what_to_bring` column (migration 014). |
| 6 | Feed card: "X going / Y max" or "Y spots left"? | **"X going / Y max"** — confirmed per wireframe screen-04c. |

## 14. Task Breakdown

### T0: Migration 014 — event_occurrences nullable + what_to_bring
**Agent:** API
**Files:**
- `apps/api/src/db/migrations/014_event_occurrences_nullable.sql` (new)

**SRS:** CRT-FR-013, DD-025
**Deps:** Migration 006 (event_occurrences table exists and deployed)
**Acceptance:**
- DROP NOT NULL on: `start_at`, `end_at`, `venue_name`, `venue_address`, `venue_point`, `city_id`, `capacity`
- ADD COLUMN `what_to_bring TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}'`
- Modify `capacity` CHECK constraint to be null-safe: `CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity > 0)`
- Migration is idempotent (use `IF EXISTS` / `IF NOT NULL`)
- Migration deployed to Supabase before any event service code is tested

**Edge cases:**
- Existing rows (0 in dev, could be non-zero in prod) are unaffected — their values stay non-null
- `CHECK (end_at > start_at)` already handles NULL gracefully (UNKNOWN result = passes)
- `CHECK (spots_booked >= 0 AND spots_booked <= capacity)` — if capacity is NULL, check passes (UNKNOWN)

### T2: Event Service
**Agent:** API
**Files:**
- `apps/api/src/services/event.service.ts` (new)

**SRS:** CRT-FR-013, CRT-FR-008, DD-025
**Deps:** T0 (migration deployed), E1.1 T2 (content.service.ts), E1.1 T3 (content-state.service.ts), T1 (schemas)
**Acceptance:**
- `createEventDraft(userId, input)` — calls `createDraft()` with `type='event'`, `pricing_model='free'`, `price_paisa=0`, then inserts stub row into `event_occurrences (content_id)` — all other fields null
- `getEventDetail(contentId, requesterId?)` — returns full event data including attendees (first 4) + total count + `has_rsvpd`
- `updateEvent(contentId, userId, input)` — validates ownership + draft status, upserts `event_occurrences` row (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), updates only provided fields
- `publishEvent(contentId, userId, tncAccepted)` — validates all required fields are non-null in event_occurrences, validates same-day, validates future date, forces free pricing, delegates to state machine (no new row needed — row already exists from first updateEvent call)
- `rsvpEvent(contentId, userId)` — validates published + future + not creator + no duplicate, atomic UPDATE + booking insert
- `cancelRsvp(contentId, userId)` — validates booking exists + event not past, delete booking + decrement spots_booked
- `listEvents(filters)` — upcoming published events with cursor pagination sorted by start_at ASC

**Edge cases:**
- Publish: read fields from `event_occurrences` row (NOT from JSONB); validate non-null: venue_name, venue_address, venue_point, city_id, capacity ≥ 1, start_at > now(), end_at > start_at, same calendar day in timezone, at least 1 media item
- Publish: force `pricing_model='free'`, `price_paisa=0`, `is_free=true` regardless of input
- Publish: NO KYC check (free events, M1)
- Unpublish: set all bookings for this event to `status='cancelled'`, UPDATE `spots_booked = 0`, send push notification to each affected user (fire-and-forget, don't block unpublish)
- RSVP: atomic UPDATE returns 0 rows → throw 409 "event_full"
- RSVP: existing booking check → throw 409 "already_rsvpd"
- RSVP: userId === event.user_id → throw 422 "own_event"
- Cancel: `GREATEST(spots_booked - 1, 0)` prevents negative
- Detail: `has_rsvpd` computed by checking `bookings` for requesterId
- List: cursor = base64(start_at|id)
- updateEvent: uses `INSERT INTO event_occurrences (content_id) ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` — safe to call multiple times

- Cover image (16:9, rounded corners, `cached_network_image` with blur placeholder)
- "EVENT" type badge (top-left overlay, same style as "POST" and "ITINERARY" badges)
- Compact date block (top-right overlay): month + day number only
- Title (max 2 lines, ellipsis, Inter semi-bold)
- Venue name + city (1 line, pin icon, soft-ink color)
- Spots info: "X going / Y max" for free events
- Creator avatar (28dp) + display name row
- "FREE" pricing badge (green, `AppColors.successSurface`) in bottom-right
- Press animation: scale 0.97, 120ms, with haptic feedback
- Tap: `context.push('/events/$id')`

**Edge cases:**
- No cover image: show placeholder with calendar icon
- Long title: 2-line truncation with ellipsis
- Past event: "Ended" badge overlay on image
- 0 attendees: show "0 going / Y max"
- Creator avatar missing: initial letter circle (AppAvatar fallback)
- Skeleton shimmer loading variant
- Reduce motion: skip press animation
